revision.title: Uy va xonalar — qisqa matnni o'qib tushunish
revision.description: Uy/xona so'zlari va qisqa tavsifni o'qib, savolga javob berish (reading).

payload.markdown:
## Bugun nimani o'rganamiz?

Uy va xonalar haqidagi so'zlarni o'rganamiz va qisqa **matnni o'qib**, savollarga javob beramiz.

## So'z boyligi

| Inglizcha | O'zbekcha |
| --- | --- |
| house | uy |
| room | xona |
| kitchen | oshxona |
| bedroom | yotoqxona |
| living room | mehmonxona |
| bathroom | hammom |
| table / chair / bed | stol / stul / karavot |
| desk | yozuv stoli |

## Qanday o'qiymiz?

Matnni diqqat bilan o'qing, keyin savolga **matndagi ma'lumot**ga qarab javob bering. Javob doim matnda bor.

payload.passage: This is my house. It has three rooms: a kitchen, a bedroom and a living room. There is a big table in the kitchen.
payload.prompt: How many rooms does the house have?

payload.passage: My bedroom is small. There is a bed, a desk and a chair. My books are on the desk.
There is a big table in the kitchen. There are four chairs around the table. The fridge is next to the window.
payload.prompt: How many chairs are in the kitchen?

payload.passage: Our living room is big. There is a sofa and a television. A small table is in front of the sofa.
payload.prompt: What is in front of the sofa?

payload.passage: My house has a kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The bathroom is next to the kitchen.
payload.prompt: How many bedrooms are in the house?

payload.markdown:
## Xulosa

- Uy so'zlari: house, room, kitchen, bedroom, living room, bathroom.
- Qisqa matnni o'qib, savolga matndagi ma'lumotga qarab javob bering.

revision.title: Kasblar — qisqa profilni o'qib tushunish
revision.description: Kasb so'zlari va qisqa shaxsiy profilni o'qib, kasb/ish joyini aniqlash (reading).

payload.markdown:
## Bugun nimani o'rganamiz?

Kasb so'zlarini o'rganamiz va qisqa **shaxsiy profil**ni o'qib, odamning kasbi va ish joyini aniqlaymiz.

## So'z boyligi

| Inglizcha | O'zbekcha |
| --- | --- |
| teacher | o'qituvchi |
| doctor | shifokor |
| driver | haydovchi |
| student | talaba |
| engineer | muhandis |
| nurse | hamshira |
| shop / hospital / school | do'kon / kasalxona / maktab |

Namuna: *I am a **teacher**. I work in a **school**.*

## Qanday o'qiymiz?

Profilni o'qing va savolga **matndagi ma'lumot**ga qarab javob bering: kasbi nima, qayerda ishlaydi.

payload.passage: My name is Laylo. I am a teacher. I work in a school in Samarkand.
This is Aziz. He is a doctor. He works in a hospital. He starts work at eight o'clock.
Dilnoza is a nurse. She works in a hospital with Aziz. She is very kind.
My father is a driver. He drives a bus in Tashkent. He likes his job.
Sardor is a student. He studies at a university in Tashkent. In the evening he works in a shop.
payload.prompt: Where does Sardor work in the evening?

payload.markdown:
## Xulosa

- Kasblar: teacher, doctor, driver, student, engineer, nurse.
- Profilni o'qib, kasb va ish joyini matndan toping.
